blueprint_book.label: Science

blueprint.label: Logistic Science
blueprint.description: 3x2 cells. Top: 222 pack machines in 3 mirrored row pairs (inserter | belt mixed belts). Bottom, turned on their side: inserters (42), transport belts (12) and two gear blocks (24 + 12, bulk inserters) feeding them. Inputs on the east edge, marked by panels: circuits 1 blue, iron 4 blue + 1 red.

blueprint.label: Military Science
blueprint.description: 4x3 cells. Top: 192 pack machines (wall | grenade, piercing belts). Walls (42, bulk) top right, grenades (150) middle right, magazines (20, bulk) bottom right, piercing rounds (60) middle left. Inputs on the east edge, marked by panels: bricks 6, coal 6, iron 5 blue belts; copper red, steel yellow.

blueprint.label: Chemical Science
blueprint.description: 3x2 cells. Two identical halves (one per cell row), each 222 machines in 3 mirrored row pairs with engine | red circuit and red circuit | sulfur belts. Outputs meet on the west edge. Inputs on the east edge, marked by panels, per half: engines red belt, red circuits 2 red belts, sulfur yellow.

blueprint.label: Production Science 15/s
blueprint.description: 15/s (1/3 belt) - place 3 for a full belt. 4x2 cells. Top left: 88 pack machines in 2 row pairs (rails on the outer belts, furnace | module in the middle). Middle: two rail blocks (32 machines each, 4 one-lane rail belts each, laid as nested L-shapes). Right: stick blocks (10, bulk) and furnace blocks (12). Bottom left: module block (64). Inputs on the east edge, marked by panels.

blueprint.label: Utility Science
blueprint.description: 2x2 cells. Two identical halves (one per cell row), each 132 machines in 3 mirrored row pairs with LDS | processing unit and frame belts. Outputs meet on the west edge. Inputs on the east edge, marked by panels, per half: LDS red belt, processing units yellow, frames yellow.

blueprint.label: Space Science (1 silo)
blueprint.description: One rocket silo, ~2.9 space science/s (1000 per launch); place ~15 for a full belt. 2x1 cells. Makes its own rocket fuel (40 assemblers, light oil by pipe) and satellites. Inputs on the east edge, marked by panels: processing units, LDS, solar panels, accumulators, radars (yellow), solid fuel (blue), light oil (pipe).

blueprint_book.description: One block per science pack, 1 full blue belt out on the left (purple 15/s and space 1 silo: place several). Inputs from the right; input belt colour = what the input needs (yellow <= 15/s, red <= 30/s, blue <= 45/s).
